messages:
Maya (AE): Quick heads-up — Orbital Labs finished the POC yesterday. Procurement says they won't raise the PO until vendor tax ID + billing contact are confirmed, and Legal has some DPA/MSA redlines. Need help routing the order form and clarifying which signature path they'll use. @Nadia can you confirm billing contact?

Nadia (Customer): Yep — billing will be with accounts@orbitallabs.io. We're US entity (EIN 12-3456789). Will sign via DocuSign.

Liam (Finance): Received — thanks. For procurement we need their PO to reference our legal entity exactly as: Redwood Inference, Inc. EIN: 12-3456789. Also confirm net terms (they asked for Net30).

Maya (AE): Net30 requested. They also asked for invoice to include cost-center 421-A if we can put that on the order form.

Olga (Solutions): From a product side, no blockers. For the order form, recommend adding a short appendix that pins the model variant and throughput SLA so Legal doesn't have to edit the MSA body. Example snippet below we can drop into the OF: 

```
Order Form: Orbital Labs
- Seats / Throughput: Dedicated 2x A100 equivalent
- Billing cadence: Monthly in arrears
- SLA target: p50 < 120ms, monthly uptime 99.5%
- Cost center: 421-A (per request)
```

Priya (Legal): Quick read: thanks. I reviewed their redlines. Two items we need to resolve before signature: 1) They removed our limitation of liability cap in §6; we need to keep a cap tied to fees. 2) DPA: they want unlimited subprocessor consent — we prefer notice + opt-out. Can we offer a narrow carve for SOC2 auditors and KMS vendors?

Maya (AE): They also asked to add SCCs for EU data flows in case they expand — currently US only but might expand in Q4.

Priya (Legal): SCCs are fine as an addendum. For the cap: propose language: "Cap on liability limited to fees paid in the prior 12 months." For DPA subprocessors: "Customer will be notified of new subprocessors and may object within 30 days; objections shall be handled in good faith." Will that be acceptable?

Nadia (Customer): That sounds reasonable. On subprocessors we just need clarity on KMS location — our security team prefers keys remain in us-east-1, not multi-region.

Diego (CS): Noted — our Private deployment can pin KMS region. If they go Dedicated we can enforce key region.

Liam (Finance): One more billing detail — procurement wants invoices to reference a Purchase Order number and include PO line items. Maya, can you ask them whether the PO will include the cost center per Olga's snippet?

Maya (AE): Pinged procurement — they confirmed PO will include cost-center 421-A and will send PO number after legal sign-off.

Priya (Legal): I'll prepare an order-form draft with the liability cap and DPA subprocessors clause. If Finance approves invoice language, I can mark it ready for signature and route via DocuSign.

Liam (Finance): Approve the invoice template. Please include a field for "PO#" and "Cost Center" on the first page.

Maya (AE): Awesome. Next steps: 1) Priya to drop redline into order form (ETA 2 business days). 2) Olga/Diego to confirm KMS pinning option in the order form language. 3) Maya will coordinate final DocuSign envelope with procurement once redlines accepted.

docu-sign-bot: Created envelope draft (env_0a9f) for review — no recipients yet.

Nadia (Customer): We'll review redlines asap. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

Maya (AE): Thanks — I'll post final OF once Priya sends the draft.
